title: 'List 1 to 30' becomes a rambling Python loop under repeat_penalty 2.0 (max_tokens is the distractor)
user_report: I asked my local model to list the numbers 1 to 30, one per line. Trivial. Instead it writes a Python loop, argues with itself about ranges, and gets cut off. Should I just raise max_tokens?

environment.hardware: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1650 4 GB, all layers offloaded
